prompt: What should be copied from P8-M to P8-R before the handover is complete?
promptZh: 交班完成前，應將哪一項從 P8-M 複製到 P8-R？
evidence: If you rebuild on a new calendar, copy the annotations separately. / Calendar P8-R: spare calendar; 18 annotations copied from P8-M at 3:00 p.m.; no time rows; not registered for export. / At 4:10 p.m., the late shift added one annotation to P8-M: leave the first Friday slot available for operator training. / Do not copy the old time rows.

options.text: The annotation asking staff to leave the first Friday slot available for operator training.
options.zh: 請將週五第一個時段留給操作員訓練的註記。
options.why: That note was added after the annotation copy and will not travel with the export.
options.whyZh: 這則註記是在複製後才新增，夜間匯出也不會帶入註記。

options.zh: 重複的週二時段資料列。
options.why: Corrected rows will arrive via export; old rows must not be copied.
options.whyZh: 匯出會提供修正後的時段資料，不可複製舊資料列。

options.text: An identical second set of the eighteen earlier annotations.
options.zh: 把先前的十八則註記完整再複製一份。
options.why: P8-R already has those annotations; the one added at 4:10 is missing.
options.whyZh: P8-R 已有那十八則，缺少的是 4:10 新增的那一則。

options.why: The systems team must register the destination separately; it is not copied as calendar content.
options.whyZh: 匯出目的地須由系統小組另行登記，並非可複製的行事曆內容。

explanationZh: 這則註記是在複製後才新增，夜間匯出也不會帶入註記。
